blocks.text: Blockchain technology is a digital system that securely stores and shares information across many computers instead of a single central server. Each verified record, or block, links to the previous one, forming an unchangeable chain. Because every computer holds a copy, altering data without detection is nearly impossible. This decentralized structure increases transparency, security, and trust by removing intermediaries like banks or governments. It allows direct, accurate, and accountable exchanges between individuals and organizations.

Blockchain has wide applications across industries. In finance, it powers cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin for secure, peer-to-peer transactions. In supply chain management, it tracks goods from origin to customer, ensuring authenticity. In data security, it provides tamper-proof storage for records like legal documents, medical files, and certificates. Governments, companies, and schools use blockchain to manage land records, supply chains, and academic credentials. Overall, blockchain enhances reliability, transparency, and efficiency in digital systems.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: From cryptocurrency to supply chain tracking, blockchain builds trust through transparency.
